selection.ownership: DNSFilter, Inc., 80 M Street SE Suite 100, Washington, DC 20003, United States. The reviewed edition is the global API at api.dnsfilter.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official DNSFilter API key/JWT authentication (Authorization header with the token itself), GET /v1/current_user, categories/policies/networks reads, rate-limit 429, Washington DC company identity, and dated incident search for DNSFilter security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying customer-account compromise found in reviewed coverage. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official DNSFilter dashboard API keys (JWTs) are sent as Authorization: <token> without a Bearer prefix, matching the pinned source. GET /v1/current_user, GET /v1/categories, GET /v1/categories/{id}, GET /v1/policies, and GET /v1/networks with page[number]/page[size] were confirmed against the pinned source and third-party API listings on 2026-09-13. Operator is DNSFilter, Inc., Washington, DC. Dated incident search found no qualifying customer-account compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v1/current_user used by the pinned credential validator.
Authorization header carries the API token itself, not Bearer, matching the pinned source and dashboard JWT docs.
Native category is utility rather than Security: Rust CATEGORIES has no security bucket; admitted ops are user, category, policy, and network reads.
Optional pageNumber and pageSize bind to documented page[number] and page[size] query names; omitted values are dropped.
Returns raw JSON:API under data rather than the source {items, links} wrapper.
id is a required encoded path segment matching GET /v1/categories/{id}.
Returns raw JSON:API under data rather than the source {item} wrapper.
Optional includeGlobalPolicies and organizationId bind to include_global_policies and organization_id; pageNumber/pageSize bind to page[number]/page[size].
Returns raw JSON:API under data rather than the source {items, links} wrapper.
Optional search plus pageNumber/pageSize are admitted; other source network flags (basic_info, count_network_ips, force_truncate_ips, protected, unprotected) are omitted.
Returns raw JSON:API under data rather than the source {items, included, links} wrapper.
GET /v1/organizations from the official Organizations API; page[number]/page[size] match existing category pagination.
GET /v1/organizations/{id} from the official Organizations API.
POST /v1/organizations with the documented { organization } body. Success is HTTP 201.
GET /v1/policies/{id} from the official Policies API.
POST /v1/policies with the documented { policy } body. Success is HTTP 201.
DELETE /v1/policies/{id}. HTTP 204 is mapped to { deleted: true }.
POST /v1/policies/{id}/add_blacklist_domain. Domain and note are required by the official schema.
POST /v1/policies/{id}/add_whitelist_domain. Domain and note are required by the official schema.
GET /v1/networks/{id} from the official Networks API.
POST /v1/networks with the documented { network } body. Success is HTTP 201.
DELETE /v1/networks/{id}. HTTP 204 is mapped to { deleted: true }.
GET /v1/networks/counts from the official Networks API.
GET /v1/users from the official Users API.
GET /v1/users/{id}; id may be a numeric id or the literal self.
GET /v1/block_pages. The provider may return a JSON array, which is wrapped under data.
GET /v1/block_pages/{id} from the official Block Pages API.
POST /v1/block_pages with the documented BlockPage body. Success is HTTP 201.
